title: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in Wikimedia…
description: A Cross-site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in the Wikimedia Foundation MediaWiki VisualEditor Extension. The flaw involves improper neutralization of input during web page generation, affecting certain program files. This vulnerability impacts multiple versions of the VisualEditor Extension, specifically from 1.43.0 before 1.43.12, from 1.45.0 before 1.45.7, from 1.46.0 before 1.46.3, and version 1.47. The issue could allow an attacker to inject malicious scripts into web pages generated by the affected software.
